lines.en: label beachsix4:
scene mayayasubeachtalk1
Several hours later, a girl who missed the earlier ordeal was treating herself to a much deserved moment of respite following a marathon of other moments that could only be described as “wack.”
lines.zh: 几个小时后，一个错过了先前那场磨难的女孩，正在享受一段她应得的喘息——在此之前，她刚跑完一长串只能用「离谱」来形容的时刻。

lines.en: It’d been a tough week for her, following a tough month of a tough year in an overwhelmingly tough life. But she would not let this dissuade her from her primary purpose in all of this.
lines.zh: 这一周对她来说很艰难，艰难的一年里艰难的一个月之后的艰难一周，而她这一生本就艰难得过分。但她不会因此偏离自己在这一切中的首要目标。

lines.en: To live and be happy. To love and be {i}free.{/i} And to find a place to rest her bones that would not send her steamrolling down a train of thought scheduled to stop at “I never should have come here.”
lines.zh: 活着，并且幸福。去爱，并且{i}自由{/i}。还要找到一个能让她歇下骨头的去处，一个不会让她顺着一列思路滚下去、最终停在「我根本不该来这儿」的地方。

lines.en: That’s where she’d get off, though. And she’d find a place to sit and attempt to convince herself she wasn’t lied to when her hopes had been lifted just a short while ago.
lines.zh: 不过她会在那一站下车。然后她会找个地方坐下，努力说服自己：就在不久前她被燃起希望的时候，并没有被骗。

lines.en: Twenty-four hours had passed since she’d arrived here and she hadn’t even heard a word from the only voice she’d come to love.
lines.zh: 从她来到这儿已经过去了二十四小时，而她连那个她唯一爱上的声音的一个字都没听到。

lines.en: {size=-1}Unbeknownst to her, however, this place brought a lingering sting for the man of her dreams that was only exacerbated by the fact that she was sitting on the same rock where he once told her he loved her.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-1}然而她并不知道，这个地方给她梦中之人留下了一道挥之不去的刺痛，而她正坐在他曾经对她说「我爱你」的那块石头上，更是雪上加霜。{/size}

lines.en: That her wasn’t her to him, though. But lately, he hadn’t been him to her either. So he and she had a lot of experimenting to do if she and he were ever going to work things out.
lines.zh: 不过，对他来说，那个她并不是她。而最近，对她来说，他也不再是他。所以如果她和他想把事情理顺，她和他有得是实验要做。

lines.en: This was not the place for that, though.
lines.zh: 但这儿可不是做那件事的地方。

lines.en: In fact, some would say this is the {i}worst{/i} place for that.
lines.zh: 事实上，有人会说这儿是{i}最糟{/i}的地方。

lines.en: And while the roof of the school had gained notoriety in recent years as the widely proclaimed “edge of the world,” that had never been and never {i}will{/i} be true.
lines.zh: 虽然学校的天台近年来声名鹊起，被广泛称作「世界边缘」，但那从来不是、也{i}永远{/i}不会是真的。

lines.en: The real edge is here — just across the water. And if you listen carefully, you might even hear a school bell or two creeping up from the bottom of the world beneath yours.
lines.zh: 真正的边缘在这里——就在水的对面。如果你仔细听，说不定还能听到一两声从你脚下那个世界的底部爬上来的校铃。

lines.en: But of course {i}she{/i} couldn’t. Wouldn’t. For she’d misplaced her mind and her heart in a dark concrete room that she would never escape. Even when she did.
lines.zh: 但{i}她{/i}当然听不到。也不会去听。因为她把自己的心和理智遗落在一间昏暗的水泥房间里，而她永远也逃不出去。即便她逃出去了。

lines.en: And maybe one day, she’d summon the resolve to swim out as far as the eye can see, then even further than that. Until she falls off the edge and starts all over in a brand new ocean.
lines.zh: 也许有一天，她会鼓起勇气，游到目光所及的最远处，然后再远一点。直到她从边缘坠落，在一片全新的海洋里重新开始。

lines.en: Oh, how she wished her lifeguard would come. And oh, how he refused to — for she was now the same as everyone else.
lines.zh: 哦，她多希望她的救生员会来。哦，而他又是多么拒绝前来——因为她现在和其他所有人没什么两样了。

lines.en: {size=-4}And the only one who {i}was{/i} special was the girl she’d grown to envy with every ounce of her decrepit heart — who laced her venom with sedatives so the congealing of her blood would dance alongside drowsiness and sing her to sleep.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-4}而唯一{i}特别{/i}的那个，是她用那颗朽坏的心里每一分力气去嫉妒的女孩——那女孩把毒液掺进镇静剂，好让她血液的凝结能伴着困意起舞，把她哄睡。{/size}

lines.en: They were friends, once upon a time.
lines.zh: 她们曾经是朋友。

lines.en: But now?
lines.zh: 但现在？

lines.en: The girl had no idea.
lines.zh: 那个女孩不知道。

lines.en: : What are you looking at?
lines.zh: 你在看什么？

lines.en: scene mayayasubeachtalk2
Also unbeknownst to her, there was a second girl who’d been here all along — thinking nicer thoughts than yesterday now that she’d escaped his/His range.
lines.zh: 她同样不知道的是，还有第二个女孩一直都在这里——因为逃离了他／祂的领域，她此刻的念头比昨天要友善些。

lines.en: scene mayayasubeachtalk3
: Uhh...hi?
lines.zh: 呃……嗨？

lines.en: The mind of the second girl wasn’t {i}all{/i} good, though. And while it remained purer than most, there was still the matter of addressing an unmistakable darkness bubbling up within it.
lines.zh: 不过这第二个女孩的念头也不是{i}全{/i}好的。虽然它依然比大多数人的更纯净，但仍有那么一团确凿无疑的黑暗在里头翻涌，需要去面对。

lines.en: She was compelled to expel this darkness. But she’d learned in recent times that listening to the voices in her head was not always good.
lines.zh: 她被驱使着要驱散这团黑暗。但她最近学到，听从脑海里的声音并不总是好事。

lines.en: This made her feel young again in the worst way possible. And she’d live in perpetual misery from this point on, knowing that just being herself would always hurt someone else.
lines.zh: 这让她以最糟的方式重新感到自己还很年轻。而从今往后，她会活在永久的痛苦里，因为她知道光是做自己，就总会伤到别人。

lines.en: In this moment, however, she thought less of the pain she may inflict on others and focused solely on a {i}new{/i} premonition. Or a “secret” as the rabbits called it.
lines.zh: 不过此刻，她少想了些自己可能对别人造成的痛苦，而专注于一个{i}新{/i}的预感。或者用兔子们的说法，一个「秘密」。

lines.en: To Yasu, it was nothing but the truth.
lines.zh: 对 Yasu 来说，那不过是真相。

lines.en: To Maya, it was an unbelievable lie.
lines.zh: 对 Maya 而言，那是个难以置信的谎言。

lines.en: : Why are you all alone?...Shouldn’t you be with your friends?
lines.zh: 你为什么一个人待着？……你不是该和朋友们在一起吗？

lines.en: : Shouldn’t {i}you{/i} not be spying on people? What happened to the leash Touka keeps you on? You’re not lost, are you?
lines.zh: {i}你{/i}不是该别再偷窥别人吗？Touka 拴你的那根绳子呢？你不是迷路了吧？

lines.en: scene mayayasubeachtalk4
: Yes and no. But it’s everyone else who is even {i}more{/i} lost, for the Light will always guide me home and neglect to even show itself to others.
lines.zh: 既是也不是。不过更{i}迷路{/i}的是其他所有人，因为光总会指引我回家，却连现身都不屑于在别人面前。

lines.en: : Or...most others at least.
lines.zh: 至少……对大多数人是这样。

lines.en: : This isn’t another recruitment speech, is it? Because I’ve already pledged to show up weekly to a shrine I don’t believe in and I’m not sure I have enough time for a church as well.
lines.zh: 这不会又是另一段招募演说吧？因为我已经承诺每周去一个我根本不信的神社报到了，我不确定自己还有没有时间再去个教堂。

lines.en: : This is no recruitment, but a warning.
lines.zh: 这不是招募，而是警告。

lines.en: scene mayayasubeachtalk5
: A warning? What kind of warning?
lines.zh: 警告？什么样的警告？

lines.en: : Bad things will happen if you stay here. You need to leave as soon as possible.
lines.zh: 如果你留在这里，坏事就会发生。你需要尽快离开。

lines.en: : But I’m afraid I can’t tell you any more than that as this secret must be kept from God as well.
lines.zh: 但恐怕我不能告诉你更多，因为这个秘密连神也要瞒着。

lines.en: scene mayayasubeachtalk6
: Ahh, okay. So {i}you’re{/i} the heretic this time and I’m just the girl you chose to wash your feet.
lines.zh: 啊，好。所以这次{i}你{/i}是那个异端，而我是你选来给你洗脚的姑娘。

lines.en: : I’m afraid I don’t understand what you mean. Faithless lies from other schools of belief do nothing but bounce off of the cage He locked my mind inside of.
lines.zh: 恐怕我不明白你的意思。其他信仰流派那些没有信仰的谎言，只会从我头脑被祂锁住的那只笼子上弹开。

lines.en: : This whole damn world is a cage, Yasu. You think you’ll find happiness just staying locked inside of it for the rest of forever?
lines.zh: 这整个该死的世界就是一只笼子，Yasu。你以为就这么永远锁在里面，就能找到幸福吗？

lines.en: : Not at all — for I will get to leave one day. And Asbeel tells me you will not.
lines.zh: 完全不是——因为有一天我会离开。而 Asbeel 告诉我，你不会。

lines.en: scene mayayasubeachtalk7
: Okay...and who the hell is Asbeel?
lines.zh: 好吧……Asbeel 到底是他妈谁？

lines.en: : A friend...who hears whispers of the end of days and cares enough to share them with us despite the penalties and pain it feels for doing so.
lines.zh: 一位朋友……它听见了末日的低语，并且足够在乎，愿把它们分享给我们，哪怕为此要承受惩罚与痛苦。

lines.en: : And this {i}friend{/i} of yours just so happened to tell you that I am a momentous figure in your latest prediction? Despite never having actually met me?
lines.zh: 而你这位{i}朋友{/i}就这么刚好告诉你，我是你最新预言里的关键人物？尽管它从来没真正见过我？

lines.en: : That is correct.
lines.zh: 没错。

lines.en: : And you expect me to believe you?
lines.zh: 而你指望我相信你？

lines.en: : No...I do not.
lines.zh: 不……我不指望。

lines.en: scene mayayasubeachtalk8
: Then why tell me at all? I’m pretty clearly trying to get some privacy over here. If I wanted to hear a sermon, I’d have come to {i}you.{/i}
lines.zh: 那你为什么要告诉我？我很明显是想在这儿清静一下。如果我想听布道，我会去找{i}你{/i}的。

lines.en: : Because I am a messenger...and it is my duty to spread the truth regardless of how harsh that truth may be. But also...
lines.zh: 因为我是个信使……而无论真相多么刺耳，传播真相是我的职责。但也因为……

lines.en: scene mayayasubeachtalk9
: Because I don’t want to hear it happen...
lines.zh: 因为我不想听见它发生……

lines.en: : And I fear what it will do to the one meant to deliver us to salvation.
lines.zh: 而且我害怕那会对那个注定要引领我们得到救赎的人造成什么。

lines.en: : Don’t want to hear {i}what{/i} happen, though? Just “bad things” doesn’t really give me anything to go off of. And listening to some psycho just makes {i}me{/i} look like an idiot in the end.
lines.zh: 不想听见{i}什么{/i}发生？光说「坏事」可给不了我任何线索。而且听一个疯子说话，最后只会让{i}我{/i}显得像个白痴。

lines.en: : It’s better to be an idiot than to be nothing at all...isn’t it?
lines.zh: 做个白痴也好过什么都不是……不是吗？

lines.en: : Sure. Whatever. Message delivered. Now, can you leave me alone and go back to your handler?
lines.zh: 行。随便吧。话传到了。现在，你能不能别烦我，回到你的看护人那儿去？

lines.en: : I already have to deal with a time-traveling rapist and her equally rapey uncle every day. Adding a cultist to the mix just makes it feel like I’m part of the world’s worst sitcom.
lines.zh: 我每天已经得应付一个时空穿越的强奸犯和她那个同样爱强奸的叔叔了。再加一个邪教徒，简直让我觉得自己活在世界最烂的情景喜剧里。

lines.en: : A sitcom...
lines.zh: 情景喜剧……

lines.en: : Yes...you are not far off at all.
lines.zh: 是啊……你说得一点都不离谱。

lines.en: : Tell me, Maya — do you know how to swim?
lines.zh: 告诉我，Maya——你会游泳吗？

lines.en: scene black
: Or are you more the “drowning” type?...
lines.zh: 还是说你更属于「溺水」那一型？……

lines.en: scene mayayasubeachtalk10
: The sky looks rather...ominous out there, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: 外面的天空看起来挺……不祥的，不是吗？

lines.en: : I wonder if it’s going to rain?
lines.zh: 我在想会不会下雨？

lines.en: : Do you like the rain, Touka?
lines.zh: 你喜欢雨吗，Touka？

lines.en: : I’m not sure I feel one way or the other about it. I suppose it’s convenient that I have my swimsuit on should it start to come down, though.
lines.zh: 我不确定自己对它是喜欢还是不喜欢。不过要是真下起来，我穿着泳衣倒是挺方便的。

lines.en: : I like the rain. Though, I’m not quite sure I can explain why.
lines.zh: 我喜欢雨。虽然我不太确定自己能不能解释清楚为什么。

lines.en: : That’s quite odd coming from someone like you. I believed there to be nothing you’d struggle to put into words.
lines.zh: 这话从你这样的人嘴里说出来可真稀奇。我还以为没什么事是你难以用语言表达的。

lines.en: : That just means you don’t know the first thing about me.
lines.zh: 那只能说明你对我一无所知。

lines.en: : Sometimes, I think I struggle with that more than anything at all.
lines.zh: 有时候，我觉得我在这方面比什么都吃力。

lines.en: : To be completely honest, I’m not sure how I {i}would{/i} know anything about you when the two of us have barely ever talked at all.
lines.zh: 老实说，我们俩几乎从没说过话，我{i}又怎么{/i}可能了解你什么呢。

lines.en: : I’m willing to learn, though. Should you oblige me, that is.
lines.zh: 不过我愿意去了解。只要你肯赏脸，那就是。

lines.en: scene mayayasubeachtalk11
: I’m a daughter. Apart from that, I’m not sure what else I’d tell you that you haven’t already discerned in school.
lines.zh: 我是个女儿。除此以外，我不确定还有什么你在学校里没看出来的事可以告诉你。

lines.en: : Mm. I figured as much was implied. But I’m glad to have found some common ground with you, however small it may be. For I, too, am a daughter.
lines.zh: 嗯。我想这也算是不言自明了。不过我还是很高兴能和你找到一点共同点，哪怕再小。因为我也同样是个女儿。

lines.en: scene mayayasubeachtalk12
: And to a quite interesting mother at that.
lines.zh: 而且是位相当有趣的母亲的女儿。

lines.en: : Tell me — do you ever brush her hair?
lines.zh: 告诉我——你会给她梳头吗？

lines.en: : My mother’s? No...She has attendants to do that should the need arise. Which it doesn’t very often seeing as it’s short and easily manageable. Likely to save her time, I presume.
lines.zh: 我母亲的？不会……需要的话有侍女来做。不过那种情况并不常见，因为她的头发很短、很好打理。大概是为了省时间吧，我猜。

lines.en: : I see. But would you if she asked?
lines.zh: 我明白了。不过如果她开口求你，你会吗？

lines.en: : Of course. I love my mother dearly despite her...peculiar outlook on fringe topics directly relevant to my life.
lines.zh: 当然。我非常爱我的母亲，尽管她……在那些与我的生活直接相关的冷门话题上见解很古怪。

lines.en: : Then I assume you’d do it without asking as well if she lost her ability to speak?
lines.zh: 那么我猜，如果她失去了说话的能力，你也会不问自做吧？

lines.en: scene mayayasubeachtalk13
: May I ask the purpose for this rather odd line of questioning, Nodoka? Is this something you do with {i}all{/i} of the girls that I was simply not aware of?
lines.zh: 我能问问你这串相当古怪的问题的用意吗，Nodoka？这是你跟{i}所有{/i}女孩都会做的事、只是我恰好不知道吗？

lines.en: : Not really. I’m just feeling somewhat melancholic. Like I’ve exhausted myself by failing too many times. And I’m beginning to ponder why it is I still persist so adamantly despite that.
lines.zh: 倒也不是。我只是有点忧郁。像是失败太多次，把自己耗干了。而我开始琢磨，尽管如此，我为什么还要这么固执地坚持。

lines.en: : I suppose that’s just the type of girl you are. One who doesn’t simply back down when things become too tough.
lines.zh: 我想你就是那种女孩吧。事情太难时不会轻易退缩的那种。

lines.en: scene mayayasubeachtalk14
: It’s not even that it’s tough. There are few questions out there I’m incapable of answering. It’s figuring out what to {i}ask{/i} that’s difficult sometimes. {i}That{/i} is what I struggle with.
lines.zh: 甚至不是难不难的问题。这世上我答不上来的问题没几个。难的是有时候要弄清楚该{i}问{/i}什么。{i}那{/i}才是我挣扎的地方。

lines.en: : Well, I’m sure it won’t help your melancholy, but I’m somewhat delighted to know that you struggle at all and are not as perfect as you present yourself.
lines.zh: 嗯，我知道这大概治不好你的忧郁，但知道你竟然也会挣扎、并不像你表现出来的那么完美，我还挺开心的。

lines.en: scene mayayasubeachtalk15
: You think I’m perfect? Why?
lines.zh: 你觉得我完美？为什么？

lines.en: : You’re a beautiful genius with no visible weakness. If that’s not the textbook definition of perfect, I don’t know what is.
lines.zh: 你是个没有明显弱点的美丽天才。如果那不是完美的教科书定义，我就不知道什么才是了。

lines.en: : Having all the required or desirable elements, qualities, or characteristics; as good as it is possible to be.
lines.zh: 具备一切必需的或理想的要素、品质或特征；好到了无以复加的程度。

lines.en: scene mayayasubeachtalk16
: Right. That. Precisely that.
lines.zh: 对。就是这个。正是这个。

lines.en: : Did I say something funny? Your expression changed.
lines.zh: 我说了什么好笑的吗？你的表情变了。

lines.en: : It’s less what was said and more {i}how{/i} you said it. Though, I suppose I shouldn’t blame you for being unable to find the humor in it when I often struggle with the same myself.
lines.zh: 与其说是你说了什么，不如说是你{i}怎么说{/i}的。不过，我想我也不该怪你找不到其中的幽默——毕竟我自己也常常为此挣扎。

lines.en: scene mayayasubeachtalk17
: I see. Then the two of us have uncovered additional common ground and you can continue to expand upon the reasons you like me.
lines.zh: 我明白了。那么我们俩又找到了更多共同点，你可以继续展开说说你喜欢我的理由了。

lines.en: : I do hope it’s not a one-way street, though. The last thing I’d want is to be on the unrequited end of yet another friendship.
lines.zh: 不过我希望这不是单行道。我最不想的，就是再次处在一场单相思友谊的那一端。

lines.en: : You want to be friends?
lines.zh: 你想做朋友？

lines.en: : I would not be opposed.
lines.zh: 我不会反对。

lines.en: : If we’re friends, can I visit your home unsupervised? Or do I need to ask you before I come over?
lines.zh: 如果我们是朋友，我能在没人看着的情况下去你家吗？还是说我得先问过你才能过去？

lines.en: scene mayayasubeachtalk18
: Is there...a {i}reason{/i} you want to visit my house unsupervised?
lines.zh: 你想在没人看着的情况下去我家，是有{i}什么理由{/i}吗？

lines.en: : You’re not planning on robbing me, are you? Because I have {i}many{/i} guards, Nodoka. You would be shockingly unsuccessful in such an endeavor despite your genius.
lines.zh: 你该不会打算抢劫我吧？因为我有{i}很多{/i}守卫，Nodoka。尽管你是个天才，这种企图你还是会失败得令人震惊。

lines.en: : It would be easiest if you were to just tell me everything you know about the everblooming sakura in your mother’s botanical garden.
lines.zh: 最省事的办法，是你直接把你母亲植物园里那棵常年盛开的樱花的一切都告诉我。

lines.en: scene mayayasubeachtalk19
: The sakura? Why do you want to know about that?
lines.zh: 樱花？你为什么想知道那个？

lines.en: scene mayayasubeachtalk20
: Because it’s one of many things in this world that defies logic. Sakura rarely bloom for more than two weeks as they rely on a multitude of factors that can’t be replicated by mere gardening.
lines.zh: 因为它是这世上许多违背逻辑的东西之一。樱花极少开放超过两周，因为它们依赖大量无法靠单纯园艺复制的因素。

lines.en: : Even if you were able to properly recreate the perfect weather cycle for one, which I’m sure is well within your family's capabilities, you’d need to change the life cycle of the petals themselves.
lines.zh: 就算你能为它完美复刻出理想的气象周期——我猜这完全在你家能力范围内——你也得改变花瓣本身的生命周期。

lines.en: : There’s pollination as well and I’ve heard nothing of your family keeping bees. Are you handling that artificially? Is the tree genetically engineered? And also, is someone buried underneath it?
lines.zh: 还有授粉的问题，而我从没听说你们家养蜜蜂。你们是人工处理的吗？那棵树是基因工程造出来的吗？还有，树底下是不是埋着什么人？

lines.en: scene mayayasubeachtalk21
: Buried under- what?! Did my younger sister tell you that blasted rumor?
lines.zh: 埋着什么——什么？！是我妹妹跟你说的那个该死的谣言吗？

lines.en: : Because Mother told her to stop spreading misinformation among the peasants and it appears as if she’s neglected to heed her warning once more.
lines.zh: 因为母亲叫她别再在平民中间散布不实信息了，看来她又一次没把警告当回事。

lines.en: : It’s not true then?
lines.zh: 那不是真的？

lines.en: scene mayayasubeachtalk22
: Of course it isn’t true. That’s ridiculous. I can’t believe Tsukasa-
lines.zh: 当然不是真的。太荒唐了。我真不敢相信 Tsukasa-

lines.en: : Your sister didn’t tell me anything.
lines.zh: 你妹妹什么都没告诉我。

lines.en: : What? Then...someone {i}else{/i} from the-
lines.zh: 什么？那是……{i}别人{/i}——

lines.en: : {i}No one{/i} told me anything.
lines.zh: {i}没有人{/i}告诉我任何事。

lines.en: : Then...where did this come from? Why would you even think such a thing?
lines.zh: 那……这从哪儿来的？你为什么会这么想？

lines.en: : A poem. Written by Ami’s mother.
lines.zh: 一首诗。Ami 的母亲写的。

lines.en: scene mayayasubeachtalk23
: Ami’s...what? Excuse me?
lines.zh: Ami 的……什么？你说什么？

lines.en: : I don’t particularly like poems.
lines.zh: 我并不怎么喜欢诗。

lines.en: : I feel as if, more often than not, they’re too easy to understand. And I much prefer the work associated with deciphering a good novel or short story instead.
lines.zh: 我觉得大多数时候，它们太容易读懂了。我更中意解读一部好小说或短篇时所需的那种功夫。

lines.en: : But someone my mother knew loved them, so I’ve casually consumed the medium in my spare time over the years when there’s nothing else available.
lines.zh: 但我母亲认识的一个人很爱诗，所以这些年来，在没有别的东西可看的时候，我也就随手翻翻这种体裁。

lines.en: : Right, yes. I understand that. But you’re saying Ami’s mother-
lines.zh: 对，是的。我明白。但你是说 Ami 的母亲-

lines.en: scene mayayasubeachtalk24
: Is an infamous poet from right here in Kumon-mi who mysteriously {i}vanished{/i} about eight years ago. But of course, {i}we{/i} know that she didn’t vanish at all. She died.
lines.zh: 是 Kumon-mi 本地一位臭名昭著的诗人，大约八年前神秘地{i}消失{/i}了。当然，{i}我们{/i}都知道她根本不是消失了。她死了。

lines.en: : And {i}before{/i} she died, she wrote one final poem dedicated to the love of her life called “The Tree That Blooms Forever” in which I believe your family’s sakura is mentioned.
lines.zh: 而在她死{i}之前{/i}，她为她一生的挚爱写了最后一首诗，叫《永远盛开的树》，我认为里面提到的就是你们家的樱花。

lines.en: scene mayayasubeachtalk25
: It sucks. Most of her later work did, in my opinion. But this one was short enough to memorize, and it goes like this.
lines.zh: 那首诗很烂。她后期的大多数作品在我看来都很烂。不过这首够短，能背下来，是这样的。

lines.en: : I’ve lost, my love. It’s over. But when I’m gone, don’t weep.\n‘Neath the tree that blooms forever, I’m not gone. I’m just asleep.
lines.zh:
我输了，我的爱。结束了。但我走了以后，别哭泣。
在那棵永远盛开的树下，我没有走。我只是睡着了。

lines.en: scene mayayasubeachtalk26
: And you think...that’s {i}our{/i} tree she’s referring to?
lines.zh: 而你认为……她指的是{i}我们家{/i}的那棵树？

lines.en: : I do.
lines.zh: 是的。

lines.en: : Nodoka...What on earth would Ami’s mother have to do with my family?
lines.zh: Nodoka……Ami 的母亲到底能和我家有什么关系？

lines.en: : I was hoping you’d be able to tell me that as well. This isn’t something I can uncover through research alone.
lines.zh: 我也希望你能告诉我这一点。这不是我单靠研究就能查出来的事。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, but...I believe you’re mistaken. There’s nothing of the sort buried beneath that tree.
lines.zh: 抱歉，但是……我认为你弄错了。那棵树底下没有埋着那种东西。

lines.en: : I suppose I know where the rumors come from now, though...
lines.zh: 不过我想我现在知道那些谣言是从哪儿来的了……

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: 我明白了。

lines.en: : I was hoping to avoid asking Sensei, but it appears I may have to now.
lines.zh: 我本来希望不用去问 Sensei，但现在看来我可能非问不可了。

lines.en: : Um...don’t? You know as well as I do that the slightest hint of tragedy sends that man spiraling downward faster than a peregrine falcon.
lines.zh: 嗯……别？你和我一样清楚，最轻微的一丝悲剧气息，都能让那个男人像游隼一样急速下坠。

lines.en: : You know about birds, Touka?
lines.zh: 你懂鸟，Touka？

lines.en: : A...fair bit. Why do you ask? Is there a poem about {i}those{/i} as well?
lines.zh: 懂……一点。为什么这么问？{i}那些{/i}也有诗吗？

lines.en: : Oh, yes. Many. But I don’t intend to ask you about or recite any of them.
lines.zh: 哦，有的。很多。不过我不打算问你，也不打算背诵任何一首。

lines.en: scene black
: I just want to know which one you see yourself as.
lines.zh: 我只是想知道你把自己看作哪一种。

lines.en: : I’ve always thought of myself as a white-fronted parrot.
lines.zh: 我一直觉得自己是一只白额鹦鹉。

$ nodoka_love += 1
{i}Nodoka’s affection has increased to [nodoka_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Nodoka 的好感度提升到了 [nodoka_love]!{/i}
